name: Home Showcase Loop
description: A player places collectible display furniture in a home, saves the layout, and exposes a social visit event for shared showcase spaces.

components.role: home plot, furniture placement, and visitor permissions

acceptanceCriteria: A player can place an owned display item inside their home plot.
Placing furniture saves the home layout.
A returning player sees the previously saved layout.
The home system records visitor entry for future social extensions.
